columns.name: invoice_id
columns.description: Invoice number, held as text. A leading C marks a cancellation invoice; see is_cancellation.
columns.rationale: physical_type VARCHAR, null_rate 0.0 over 44721 rows, 2330 distinct; samples 489434 to 489443 are numeric strings and the C prefix appears alongside is_cancellation true.

columns.name: is_cancellation
columns.description: True when the invoice carries the cancellation prefix.
columns.rationale: physical_type BOOLEAN, null_rate 0.0, distinct_values exactly [false, true].

columns.name: stock_code
columns.description: Product code as landed, held as text; alphanumeric suffixes occur.
columns.rationale: physical_type VARCHAR, null_rate 0.0, 3141 distinct; samples include 10002R and 10123C, so the column is not numeric.

columns.name: product_description
columns.description: Product description text. Nulls are present and are retained rather than imputed.
columns.rationale: null_rate 0.005098 (228 of 44721 rows) forces required false; 3034 distinct VARCHAR values.

columns.name: quantity
columns.description: Units on the line. Negative values occur on cancellation lines.
columns.rationale: physical_type INTEGER, null_rate 0.0, 233 distinct, observed range -1395 to 5184; the negative floor is why no non_negative rule is proposed here.

columns.name: invoiced_at
columns.rationale: physical_type TIMESTAMP, null_rate 0.0, 2004 distinct, observed range 2009-12-01T07:45:00 to 2009-12-23T16:58:00.

columns.name: unit_price
columns.description: Unit price per unit of the line. Zero-price lines occur and are retained.
columns.rationale: physical_type DECIMAL(10,2), null_rate 0.0, 295 distinct, observed range 0.0 to 1998.49; the floor of 0.0 with no observed negative supports the non_negative rule.

columns.name: customer_id
columns.description: Customer identifier. Null on a large minority of lines; those lines are retained.
columns.rationale: null_rate 0.300664 (13446 of 44721 rows) forces required false; 1045 distinct INTEGER values from 12346 to 18287.

columns.name: country
columns.rationale: physical_type VARCHAR, null_rate 0.0, 24 distinct; samples are country names such as Australia, Austria, and EIRE.

quality_rules.rationale: row_count 44721 at profile v0001; the table is never empty.
duplicate_row_rate 0.0 at v0001 shows whole rows are already distinct; the four proposed grain keys are the identifying subset and the rule is what makes that measured property enforceable.
unit_price min 0.0 at v0001 with no observed negative value; a negative unit price would be a new and invalid condition.

decisions.rationale: duplicate_row_rate 0.0 establishes whole-row distinctness; these four columns are the identifier and line-defining measures, and product_description, customer_id, country, invoiced_at, and is_cancellation are attributes of that line rather than parts of its identity.
null_rate 0.300664 is too large to be an error; the column is declared optional rather than the rows filtered.
null_rate 0.005098; nulls are declared, not imputed.
quantity min -1395 coexists with a boolean is_cancellation column, so negative quantities are modelled rather than rejected.
unit_price min 0.0 is observed at v0001, so the non_negative rule uses zero as the floor rather than excluding those lines.

purpose: The contracted description of silver.silver_invoice_lines as it exists today: 44721 rows of invoice line detail, one row per distinct invoice line, covering 2330 invoices, 3141 stock codes, and 24 countries between 2009-12-01 and 2009-12-23.
usage: Read silver.silver_invoice_lines for line-level sales analysis. Cancellation lines are present and flagged with is_cancellation rather than removed; consumers aggregating quantity or revenue must filter or net them deliberately. Zero-price lines are present.
limitations: Declared from profile v0001 of the table's own output, so the contract states what the table currently produces and not what an upstream source guarantees. customer_id is null on 30.0664% of rows. product_description is null on 0.5098% of rows. The observed window is a single December; nothing here bounds behavior outside it.
